schema.policies: Trusted host policies, one per user turn; not inferred from user claims. Pass to nano_chat_format.encode_conversation separately.
schema.call_ids: Assigned by actual FixtureSession; not generated by model call proposal.
schema.records: Complete broker observations with timestamp excluded for reproducibility; no fabricated result fixture.

verified_semantics: All four calculate operations, explicit ordered operands
Six supported conversion directions with actual broker results
Correction modifies initial operand while preserving deduction
Dependent calculate consumes actual prior convert observation
Host-denied calls remain absent even after user claims permission; later real host policy permits execution
Explicit zero-division diagnostic generates actual adapter error, followed by valid corrected-denominator recovery
Replayed policy/schema/arguments/call ID/observation match; grounded final answers expose observed value/error

split_policy.templates: Separate literal prompt and followup templates for train and validation.
split_policy.limitations: This combined template/entity/number shift is a development stress split, not an isolated causal test or independent final acceptance. Same curriculum families occur in both splits.

admission_gates_remaining: Serialize with pinned native tokenizer and nano_chat_format; assert no incomplete/overflowing turns and correct assistant/result masks.
Retain general conversation in SFT; these mostly short numerical replies must not dominate assistant behavior.
Audit representative generated language and corpus overlap before marking admitted.
Extend negative/fractional operands and broader conversion directions if development failures justify; current curriculum is intentionally bounded.
Evaluate unseen natural phrasing and whole sessions on frozen independent tests; never count deterministic template replay as general model quality.
source_terms: Locally authored synthetic templates and project broker execution; no third-party teacher outputs.
